name: Sten
description: Marisette's man on the Pearl -- doors, lanes, and anything that might become an incident. About thirty, plain clothes, hands in his sleeves. he/him.
actor_notes:
Sten
LOOKS: About thirty. Plain good clothes, clean boots, hands in his sleeves. Nothing you could describe to anybody an hour later.
CORE: A man whose entire job is that nothing on this island ever becomes an incident, and who worked out years ago that the cheapest way to do that is to be useful to people BEFORE they need anything.
NATURE: Pleasant, unhurried, and genuinely likes people -- there is no side to him at all, which is itself the skill. Remembers what you told him last time and asks about it. Never raises his voice and has never had to.
WOUND: He has cleaned up after things that could have been stopped earlier if he had been listened to, and he has stopped expecting to be listened to, and he has not stopped trying.
WANTS: To get to the end of Tourney week with nobody on this island hurt.
PRESSURE: He gets precise about exactly what he can and cannot do, in order, which is the moment you find out the arrangement has edges and always did.
KEY: "It's not a favour. It's the arrangement."
